scope: S129 district ambient: one line per city district (66), CN/EN parity, tied to district function; no rewards, no task progress, no knowledge leaks
rules: 按街区写：只谈本街的功能、规矩与街面，不替台本当事人发言
不含奖励、不推进任务、不写状态键；与四套闲谈池不重复
每街区一句，链接本城卡；不改任何结算

lines.cn: 告示一贴三份，缺街那份总是最后补。
lines.en: Notices go up in three copies; the one missing a street gets patched last.

lines.cn: 门框上的年刻比租牌准。租牌能补，年刻补不了。
lines.en: The year cuts on the doorframe outlast the rent plates. Plates get replaced; cuts do not.

lines.cn: 这条街认吃水，不认旗子。
lines.en: This street reads draft lines, not banners.

lines.cn: 副工场的活按件算。件数清，人就不清。
lines.en: Side-workshop work is counted by the piece. The count is clear; the people are not.

lines.cn: 水门开合看潮，不看人。
lines.en: The water gate opens by the tide, not by faces.

lines.cn: 夜里谈事的都坐墙边。墙边听得清，也退得快。
lines.en: Night talkers sit by the wall. By the wall you hear well and leave fast.

lines.cn: 岸上的屋修了三回。第三回换了地基。
lines.en: The shore house was rebuilt three times. The third time we changed the foundation.

lines.cn: 驻点外街白天忙，夜里空。
lines.en: The outer street is busy by day and empty by night.

lines.cn: 补网先补洞眼大的，小的自己会拉大。
lines.en: Mend the big holes first; small ones widen on their own.

lines.cn: 摆渡看水位桩，不看天色。
lines.en: The ferryman reads the gauge post, not the sky.

lines.cn: 后场晒粮，前场议事。两场不混。
lines.en: The back yard dries grain; the front yard argues. They do not mix.

lines.cn: 磨停了，侧院还堆着磨石。
lines.en: The mill stopped; the side yard still holds the stones.

lines.cn: 粮棚记进出，不记名字。
lines.en: The grain shed logs what comes and goes, not who.

lines.cn: 溪桥过一辆车就够窄了。
lines.en: The creek bridge is narrow enough for one cart.

lines.cn: 坡上的葡萄归谁，看藤架不看地契。
lines.en: Who owns the slope grapes follows the trellis, not the deed.

lines.cn: 共用的窖，位子比酒贵。
lines.en: In a shared cellar the slot costs more than the wine.

lines.cn: 后街的活计不挂牌，靠喊。
lines.en: Back-street work is not posted; it is shouted.

lines.cn: 小院只卖当批的酒。批号写在桶沿。
lines.en: The yard sells only the current batch; the batch number is on the cask rim.

lines.cn: 外街的炉子只烧小件。大件进院。
lines.en: Outer-street forges fire small pieces; big work goes inside.

lines.cn: 护具修院不接急活。急了，就修不好。
lines.en: The armour yard takes no rush jobs. Rushed, it will not mend right.

lines.cn: 外庭先看来意，再看衣冠。
lines.en: The outer court asks your business first, your dress second.

lines.cn: 旧墙拆一半就停。剩下的那半是界线。
lines.en: The old wall was half pulled down. The rest is the boundary.

lines.cn: 试装小场量三处：肩、肘、膝。
lines.en: The fitting yard measures three points: shoulder, elbow, knee.

lines.cn: 会馆只认登记的手艺，不认口头师承。
lines.en: The hall honours registered crafts, not spoken lineage.

lines.cn: 工棚记炉次，不记人情。
lines.en: The shed logs furnace runs, not favours.

lines.cn: 寄柜只收现，不收欠条。
lines.en: The deposit cabinet takes coin, not notes.

lines.cn: 支沟的水烫过手，别试。
lines.en: The cooling channel has scalded hands. Do not test it.

lines.cn: 料市按批卖。批完了就收摊。
lines.en: The material market sells by batch. Batch done, stall closed.

lines.cn: 晒架上的毛按天翻。翻晚了会霉。
lines.en: Fleece on the racks is turned daily. Turn it late and it moulds.

lines.cn: 侧棚的机子慢，慢的织得匀。
lines.en: The side shed loom runs slow; slow weaves even.

lines.cn: 水堰洗毛，洗三次才算净。
lines.en: The weir washes fleece; three rinses to be clean.

lines.cn: 布市限匹数，谁也不能多拿。
lines.en: The cloth market limits bolts; nobody takes extra.

lines.cn: 新院先立条，再收货。
lines.en: The new yard sets its slips before taking goods.

lines.cn: 住棚街的名字还是拟定的。
lines.en: The shelter street is still only provisionally named.

lines.cn: 见证亭只记谁在场，不记谁有理。
lines.en: The witness pavilion records who was present, not who was right.

lines.cn: 侧门道没名字，走的人不少。
lines.en: The side gate path has no name, and no shortage of walkers.

lines.cn: 边院堆的是等锯的料。
lines.en: The side yard stacks timber waiting for the saw.

lines.cn: 岗外三步是林线，越线要问。
lines.en: Three steps past the post is the tree line; crossing needs asking.

lines.cn: 木排靠岸要看水，不看力气。
lines.en: Rafts beach by water, not by strength.

lines.cn: 弓料要阴干，棚里不见太阳。
lines.en: Bow staves dry in the shade; no sun in this shed.

lines.cn: 支井口封过两次，两次都开了。
lines.en: The side shaft was sealed twice, and opened twice.

lines.cn: 粗矿过秤先扣石。
lines.en: Coarse ore is weighed with the rock deducted first.

lines.cn: 通风院的人先下，最后上。
lines.en: Ventilation crews go down first and come up last.

lines.cn: 存柜只收旧物，不收新货。
lines.en: The cabinet stores old goods only, never new stock.

lines.cn: 外坡种的是纪念树，不结果。
lines.en: The slope grows memorial trees; they bear no fruit.

lines.cn: 家院里的人都活着，地还没分完。
lines.en: The household survived; the land is not divided yet.

lines.cn: 围栏道只修一半，另一半靠喊。
lines.en: Half the fence path is mended; the other half relies on shouting.

lines.cn: 小亭只修旧物，不做新件。
lines.en: The kiosk mends old things, never makes new ones.

lines.cn: 驿馆登记来处，不问去处。
lines.en: The post house logs where you came from, not where you go.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.cn: 外场复量一遍，少的自己补。
lines.en: The yard re-measures; shortfalls are made up by the carrier.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.cn: 旁路是运石踩出来的。
lines.en: The side path was worn by hauling stone.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.cn: 交换场只换物，不换人情。
lines.en: The exchange trades goods, not favours.
lines.link: 聚落_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

lines.cn: 营里分区，先分区再分人。
lines.en: The camp is zoned first, staffed second.
lines.link: 聚落_ASH_寒凉盆地与护理村

lines.cn: 水堤上不许洗东西。
lines.en: Nothing is washed on the water bank.
lines.link: 聚落_ASH_寒凉盆地与护理村

lines.cn: 井口的风比井里冷。
lines.en: The wind at the well mouth is colder than below.
lines.link: 聚落_ASH_寒凉盆地与护理村

lines.cn: 接收棚先问自愿，再问名字。
lines.en: The shelter asks willingness first, names second.
lines.link: 聚落_ASH_寒凉盆地与护理村

lines.cn: 钟站不敲钟了，螺栓还在换。
lines.en: The station rings no bells; the bolts still get replaced.

lines.cn: 维护廊只走外圈，不进内院。
lines.en: The maintenance walk circles outside; it never enters the inner court.

lines.cn: 议桌不设主位。
lines.en: The table has no head seat.

lines.cn: 封条路按季度查，不看人情。
lines.en: The sealed road is checked quarterly, not by favour.

lines.cn: 民粮巷的价一天一变。
lines.en: Prices in the grain lane change daily.

lines.cn: 迁藏屋的书箱编了号，号对不上就停。
lines.en: The moving-store crates are numbered; a mismatch stops the work.

lines.cn: 残庭只留石座，不种花。
lines.en: The broken court keeps stone seats, not flowers.

lines.cn: 旧织街的机子还在响，只是没人听了。
lines.en: The old weaving street still clatters; fewer listen.

lines.cn: 封火小院只留一盏火。
lines.en: The banked-fire yard keeps a single flame.

lines.cn: 接应棚不问旧名，只问去向。
lines.en: The receiving shed asks not your old name, only where you go.
